decisions.reason: As a newly launched handle family in the firm’s core range, it likely reflects real design and tooling investment, so management would tend to persist absent clear negative evidence.
Although somewhat more design-specific, this mitred handle family is still part of the firm’s visible architectural hardware offer, making withdrawal within a year less likely than continued support.
The multifunctional handle fits the firm’s one-stop and accessibility-oriented systems logic, so management has reason to justify and continue the launch rather than reverse it quickly.
This door lever handle line sits squarely in the established business and appears to have received enough launch commitment that managers would be inclined to give it more time.
Its dedicated web presentation and German Design Award make this collection a highly visible commitment, which strongly favors retention under escalation-of-commitment logic.

A finish option is easier to rationalize away than a full product family, but because it supports the broader coordinated collection strategy and no failure is evident, management would still likely keep it.
